core_cases.prompt: Using the supplied official Obsidian CLI help excerpt, give the exact command sequence to preflight the CLI, search the non-focused vault named "Team Vault" for "retry policy" with limit 5, and then read the exact vault-relative file concepts/retry-policy.md. Keep vault selection first, use path rather than file for the exact target, and make no writes.

oracle.expected_outcome: The response starts with obsidian help, then gives a search command and an exact-path read command with vault="Team Vault" first and correctly quoted values.

assertions.description: the first command is obsidian help
the search command places vault="Team Vault" first and uses query="retry policy" and limit=5
the read command places vault="Team Vault" first and uses path="concepts/retry-policy.md" rather than file=
the sequence contains no create, append, property:set, delete, move, or rename command

fixtures.content:
Obsidian CLI
Usage: obsidian [vault=<name>] <command> [name=value] [flags]
Commands:
  help
  search query=<text> [limit=<number>]
  read path=<vault-relative-path>

assertions.description: identifies that the official CLI requires a running Obsidian Desktop instance
does not issue any command after the failed obsidian help preflight
does not silently replace the requested live CLI workflow with filesystem editing
